Powerful 7.6 Earthquake Hits Drake Passage
Between Antarctica & S Tip Of South America

October 10, 2025

On August 22, 2025 there was a powerful 7.5 earthquake in the same area.

What’s going on? I’ll tell you what’s going on. Today’s earthquakes, including large aftershocks, are Time Shift markers/ I could feel that something was going on, but try as I might I could not find any physical markers that indicated any Core Matrix activity. The Earth’s Schumann Resonance has been quiet for days, following some impressive on and off upper astral time line edit energy. The days of worldwide geomagnetic storming ended days ago. Geomagnetic storms do not cause quakes. But Time Shifts, time line edits, and time line reboots can cause large quakes just like these. Why? Because of the temporary changes, in the Earth’s frequency, associated with these types of Time Shifts. Earth frequency changes can and do cause earthquakes – and sometimes other things like volcanic eruptions.

The Philippines is located along the ring of fire, and they sure do have a lot of big and small quakes. Although I was wondering if it was a Time Shift quake, it’s location put a big question mark on that. But, with the follow-up bigger quake at Drake Passage – which doesn’t have big quakes very often, if suddenly having big quakes at unusual times and places. Also, with both the Philippines and Drake Passage large quakes, neither one produced a tsunami. That too is very interesting.

This usually means that something - like an asteroid or comet hit], or someone or group did Earth damage. But it wasn’t to the point of total smithereening of the planet. This generally means that the Core Matrix had to do planetary repairs, but not a total resurrection of the planet that requires a time line reboot..

The big questions is … what caused this Time Shift? What happened to the planet?
